name: Aozora Tsubame
source:
Occupation: Student

Subject: Physical education

Personality: A girl with a strong will and a penchant for iaido. She is also Tsugumi's twin sister. She has no mercy for the main character.
She is a bit of a weirdo, and gives Tsugumi a hard time when she is in a panic.

[From [url=http://mbstruth.com/katei/cha/tuba01.html]official site[/url]]
